synopsis: Yume Kawai, an 18-year-old, is about to start her first day as a working adult. Through sheer passion and determination, she's managed to secure a job at her dream company—a renowned fancy goods manufacturer responsible for creating beloved characters like Twinkle Kururu, which Yume adores. However, Yume harbors a secret: due to a hurtful comment from a boy in her childhood, she has suppressed her genuine love for all things cute. Now, as she embarks on her professional journey, Yume must confront her hidden feelings and rediscover her true self. (Source: Natalie, translated)

synopsis: "Standing above all and controlling the masses. That is the way of life I aspire to!" Ikurumi Akuto is the top of his class in every subject, including sports, and he knows it. The son of a well-known politician, a degree of arrogance is to be expected. But Akuto takes it to a new extreme with his condescending and self-important attitude. The friends he may have had in his elementary years have long since left his side, and it doesn't help matters that his effeminate voice makes him a target of constant ridicule by his "lower class" schoolmates. Then Harusaka Nari enters his life, and Akuto's controlling personality is thrown off kilter by the optimistic but manipulating young seiyuu. With his life on the line, he agrees to be a voice in her Anime Research Society's project for the upcoming Cultural Festival...as the female lead?!

titleNative: 上杉くんは女の子をやめたい
synonyms: Uesugi-kun wants to quit being a girl
synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
